Fair Value Measurements Fair value is defined as the price that would be received from the sale of an asset or paid to transfer a liability in the principal or most advantageous market in an orderly transaction between market participants on the measurement date. To measure the fair value of assets and liabilities, the Company uses the following fair value hierarchy based on three levels of input: Level 1—observable inputs, such as quoted prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities; Level 2—significant other observable inputs that are observable either directly or indirectly; and Level 3—significant unobservable inputs for which there is little or no market data, which require the Company to develop its own assumptions. Judgment is involved in estimating inputs, such as discount rates, used in Level 3 fair value measurements. Changes to these inputs can have a significant effect on fair value measurements and amounts that could be realized. Overview Our mission is to transform the lives of people with diabetes. We develop, manufacture, and sell proprietary continuous insulin delivery systems for people with insulin-dependent diabetes. Our Omnipod platform includes our latest-generation Omnipod 5 and its predecessor, Omnipod DASH, both of which eliminate the need for multiple daily injections using syringes or insulin pens and avoid the need for a traditional insulin pump and tubing. Omnipod DASH features a secure Bluetooth enabled Pod that is controlled through a smartphone-like Personal Diabetes Manager (“PDM”) with a color touch screen user interface. Omnipod 5, which builds on our Omnipod DASH mobile platform, is a tubeless automated insulin delivery (“AID”) system that integrates with a continuous glucose monitor (“CGM”) to automate insulin delivery and is fully controlled by a compatible personal smartphone or the Omnipod 5 Controller. It is indicated for people with type 1 diabetes and, in the United States, for adults with type 2 diabetes. The CGM is sold separately by third parties. The Omnipod 5 Pod integrates with Dexcom, Inc.’s G6 and G7 CGMs and with Abbott Diabetes Care, Inc.’s (“Abbott”) FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus sensor (“Libre 2 Plus”) in various markets. In June 2026, we expanded U.S. compatibility to include Abbott’s FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus sensor (“Libre 3 Plus”) and announced the U.S. rollout of Omnipod 5 algorithm enhancements, including a lower target glucose setting of 100 mg/dL. In addition, we recently expanded Omnipod 5 integration with Libre 3 Plus to 10 additional countries. Our financial objective is to sustain profitable growth. To support this objective, we continue to expand the availability of Omnipod 5 in international markets. In February 2026, we launched Omnipod 5 and Omnipod Discover ® , our web-based data platform designed for Omnipod 5 users, their caregivers, and healthcare providers, in five countries in the Middle East, and in July 2026, we launched Omnipod 5 and Omnipod Discover in Spain. In addition, in October, we launched Omnipod Discover in the United States. We are also strengthening our international commercial organization and advancing regulatory, reimbursement, and market development initiatives to support future launches in additional markets. In the United States, we sell our products through the pharmacy channel, which expands access and improves affordability by eliminating upfront costs. We also continue to increase awareness of Omnipod products through our direct-to-consumer advertising programs. We continue to advance key product innovation initiatives, including expanding smartphone integration and CGM compatibility for Omnipod 5 and enhancing the customer experience through digital product and data capabilities. We are progressing the development of Omnipod 6, our next-generation AID system, and have completed enrollment for the type 1 diabetes cohort in our STRIVE 2 study. In addition, we continue to advance the development of our fully closed-loop AID system for people with type 2 diabetes, including completion of enrollment in the EVOLVE pivotal study, which is intended to support a planned 510(k) submission in 2027. Finally, we continue to strengthen our global manufacturing capabilities, including investing in a new manufacturing plant in Costa Rica, to support our continued growth and future demand. Results of Operations Factors Affecting Operating Results Our Pod is intended to be used continuously for up to three days, after which it may be replaced with a new disposable Pod. The unique patented design of the Omnipod allows us to provide Pod therapy at a relatively low or no up-front investment in regions where reimbursement allows for it. Our pay-as-you-go pricing model reduces the up-front financial risk for third-party payors. As we grow our customer base, we expect to generate an increasing portion of our revenues through sales of our disposable Pods, which provide a recurring revenue stream. We recorded a net charge of $38.5 million associated with the MDCs during the nine months ended September 30, 2026. We estimate total costs associated with the MDCs will be approximately $50 million, most of which we expect to incur in 2026.
